title: Finite-type flatness gives a finitely presented etale neighborhood
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], let $\mathcal F$ be a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module of finite type [def-weil-pbc-module-finite-type-presentation], and let $x\in X$ with $s=f(x)$ such that $\mathcal F_x$ is flat over $\mathcal O_{S,s}$ [def-weil-flat-morphism]. Then there are an etale neighborhood $(S',s')\to(S,s)$ [def-weil-etale-morphism] and an open subscheme $V\subset X\times_S\operatorname{Spec}(\mathcal O_{S',s'})$ [def-pc-fibre-product; def-weil-open-immersion] containing the point $x'$ over $x$ such that the pullback of $\mathcal F$ to $V$ is of finite presentation and flat over $\mathcal O_{S',s'}$ [def-weil-pbc-module-finite-type-presentation; def-weil-flat-morphism].
